01 / Feed the bird

Headers in. Breadcrumbs out.

256 KiB maximum. EML bodies are ignored; binary Outlook .msg files are unsupported. In Gmail, choose “Show original”; elsewhere, find the message source. This bird reads headers, not minds.

A pigeon, not a judge

A “pass” is not a halo.

Header fields can be forged. A reported “pass” does not make a message safe, and a reported “fail” does not establish malicious intent. HomingPigeon does not perform DNS authentication or verify signatures.
